new_candidates.body:
Revert the following from nav2_package.cmake once BT.CPP is fixed

```
    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" AND
        CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL 15 AND
        CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION VERSION_LESS 16)
      # GCC 15 false positive: warns in BehaviorTree.CPP's ThreadSafeSignal subscriber vector copy.
      list(APPEND NAV2_COMPILE_OPTIONS -Wno-error=null-dereference)
    endif()
```

https://github.com/BehaviorTree/BehaviorTree.CPP/issues/1288 issue with fix https://github.com/BehaviorTree/BehaviorTree.CPP/pull/1287

Original Ci failure which is temporary workaround was required for https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/ros-navigation/navigation2/20894/workflows/59d58163-6fb9-445d-b8cf-393fce4225e8/jobs/67662
new_candidates.title: Revert nav2_package.cmake null deference exclusion after BT.CPP is fixed
